svg.title: AIDER architecture
svg.desc: Current AIDER: 8 anchor frames and neighbors; frozen VITAL and SlowFast, frame-wise BLIP with trainable text and temporal self-attention; motion-compensated multiscale artifact prior; two learned artifact queries and gated residual fusion; task-private base FiLM plus shared cross-branch video residual modulation; channel concatenation to width 1536; two 12-head attention blocks, each with 7 Top-2 routed FFNs and 1 always-on shared FFN; private frame-wise heads and temporal averaging. Optional task-expert MI regularizes pre-Top-K Gate probabilities, with zero weight by default.
svg.text: 7 Top-2 Routed FFNs + 1 Always-On Shared FFN per block
Private: task FiLM / α / Gates / Heads. Shared: video adapters / attention / experts.
Same modulation coefficients broadcast over all T frames
